Partial unit — 17 of 19 rooms. Entrance Lobby, Roof carry manual snags but have no 360° capture in this Matterport model, so there is nothing to inspect. Their 13 manual snags are listed below as not covered by the capture and are excluded from every percentage on this page; the figures cover the 328 manual snags in the 17 rooms that have been scored end to end. Parking Approach is inspected too, with no manual counterpart to score against. For those rooms the v1 page remains the only assessment.

How these numbers are measured. An independent reviewer checks every manual snag against the AI repair list, without being told which method raised what, and rules it covered, partially covered or not covered on whether a contractor working that list would fix it — not on matching wording. Snags no photograph can settle — a tap test, an operation check, an element out of the camera's view — are set aside as not assessable and listed, never dropped.

Not on this page. object-level grouping has not been run for this unit, so the rooms' AI rows are grouped by defect type per room instead of one row per physical object; the Snag Recall judge has not been run for this unit, so both recall tiles are omitted; the row-summary pass has not been run for this unit, so those rows' summary line is the first linked observation's own wording; Snag Yield is omitted until the actionability audit covers every scored room — its definition removes false positives first, and an uncorrected yield would overstate the AI side.
